text:
morgan: Harborway submitted a vendor risk form + SOC2 scoping questions. Deadline is EOD Friday. Main asks: embeddings pseudonymization, non-prod access, EU audit-log retention, and whether Private deployment changes DPA language. Filing ticket RISK-1123.

vendor-forms-bot: Ticket created: RISK-1123 — assigned to #customer-success.

sam: Thanks — quick note on pseudonymization: our hosted embeddings pipeline supports hashed identifiers and an optional pseudonymization step. Need legal sign-off on the exact wording for "pseudonymize" in the form. cc @elaine_legal :eyes:

elaine_legal: Looking now. Short answer: we can confirm pseudonymization for customer-provided PII if they opt into an "Embeddings Pseudonymization Addendum". I'll draft the clause. Also need clarity on the retention window they expect.

morgan: They indicated 90 days for embeddings in their response, but they're also asking about derived artifacts (search indexes). They want a guarantee that derived indexes can be deleted on request.

ryan_infra: Tech details: we can delete embedding vectors + mark index entries for tombstone removal. For Private/Dedicated customers we can expose a purge API. For Hosted customers we need a two-step workflow: mark for deletion + background compaction which can take up to 48–72 hours depending on shard compaction. I'll outline the steps for the reply.

ben_solutions: Sharing the common snippet I send to customers for Hosted vs Dedicated setups:

```
embeddings:
  retention_days: 90
  pseudonymize: true
  allow_purge_api: false
```

For Dedicated/Private we flip allow_purge_api: true.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll send that snippet to Harborway and ask whether they want the purge API enabled (Dedicated) or the Hosted compaction flow. Also a question: Harborway wants confirmation on SOC2 scope — specifically whether non-prod is included.

elaine_legal: SOC2 scoping guidance: by default we include production systems and production data. Non-prod can be excluded if we can demonstrate controls that prevent production PII from flowing into non-prod (masking, separate keys, no prod backups). For them we'll need a dataflow diagram to validate.

morgan: Harborway uploaded a diagram but it doesn't show non-prod paths or backups. I asked them to update the diagram; they replied with a short note. Can someone list the exact artifacts we need from them?

ryan_infra: Things to confirm in the dataflow: backup replication targets and retention, analytics/export sinks, whether dev sandboxes are seeded with production snapshots, and any external log/metric forwarding (SIEMs) that cross regions (EU vs US). Also whether encryption keys are customer-managed for Private deployments.

elaine_legal: I'll draft a short paragraph we can paste into the form offering options: pseudonymization addendum (yes/no), retention window (e.g., 30/90/365 days), purge API availability (Hosted: compaction flow; Dedicated/Private: purge API), and Private deployment audit support (we can provide audit artifacts for on-prem/private with NDA). Will circulate a draft by EOD Thursday.

sam: Great — I'll reply to Harborway with the snippet + ask for an updated dataflow showing non-prod and backups. @elaine_legal please BCC legal@redwood so we have a record.

vendor-forms-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up with Harborway in 48 hours.

morgan: Owners: sam = reply to customer; elaine_legal = draft legal text; ryan_infra = confirm purge steps + timelines. Action: mark renewal risk as low unless they insist on <30 day retention across the board. /priority P2
